label: High-Density Mobile Shelving Unit
description: Industrial-grade, mobile shelving system designed to maximize storage density for museum collections. Operated via a hand crank to open and close aisles.

components.function: Structural support for shelves and integrated drawer units. Protects contents from light and dust when compacted.
Allows shelving units to move along the floor, compacting or expanding aisles.
Player-interactable element to manually move shelving units, opening or closing aisles. Provides haptic feedback.
Holds multiple 'dino-archive-drawer-001' units. Slots can be empty or filled.
Open bays for storing larger specimens, often within 'jackets' (plaster/burlap casts) or custom crates.
Displays range of accession numbers, taxonomic groups, or geological periods stored within the adjacent shelves.

game_mechanics.movement_puzzle: Player must operate the hand crank to shift shelving units, creating an aisle to access a desired section. Units may 'lock' or jam, requiring a mini-game to free them.
game_mechanics.capacity_management: Limited open aisles mean the player must strategically move units to reach different collection areas. Some areas might be inaccessible until specific units are moved.
game_mechanics.environmental_hazard: Operating the units too quickly or improperly could cause a minor tremor, potentially dislodging a fragile specimen (leading to a quick-time event to catch it).

asset_relationships.notes: Each shelving unit can contain numerous individual archive drawers.
